commits.message: Fixed ridiculous Windows issues in order to automate the build.
Fixed fuzz MSVC9 project to automatically build IFuzzExtension.h file.
Updated fuzz-example-extension to be compatible up to Firefox 3.7.*.
Incremented the Fuzz version from 0.9 to 0.10.
Updated max allowable Firefox version to 3.7.x.
Fixed small build issues in Windows for Fuzz plugin.

Updated Fuzz and FuzzExample for release. Removed extraneous code, added
more documentation, removed log verbosity.

Fixed a number of Fuzz and FuzzExample related bugs. This is the
first version that works fairly well on multiple documents.

Fixed a number of issues with the Fuzz Example UI and Fuzz to Fuzz-Example
messaging bridge.

Fixed a number of functional bugs, added new features, and updated the
Fuzz Example UI XUL.

Added Firefox 3 Fuzz extension example to demonstrate how to create Fuzz-based
extensions in Firefox.

Renamed firefox directory to fuzz-addon. Getting ready to add
Fuzz-based Firefox extension example.

Added i386 extension to XPI files for Fuzzbot, changed dist/ directory
to top-level directory in source package.

Removed a great deal of code from Fuzz, stripping down functionality. The
only thing left is the triple viewer.

Fixed some compilation bugs that caused the plugin to be built
incorrectly.

Changed MSVC solution name to match new split between Fuzz
and Clarity.
Renamed all "*uzzbot" files to "*uzz".

Changed all "uzzbot" to "uzz" and "UZZBOT" to "UZZ" in preparation for
splitting the triple extraction and triple display interfaces.

Removed 3rd party directory since it is not used for the
Windows build.
Updated Linux build to use xulrunner-1.9 instead of 1.8.
Fixed Mac OS X build for i386 machines.
Fixed some Windows build issues while using MSVC 9.

Updated FuzzbotExtension.cpp to include DLL entry point for Windows
library.

Added Windows Tidy library and fixed Linux build to use newly
defined XULRUNNER_* autoconf variables. Added support for using
mozilla-config.h and xpcom-config.h files.
Added expat 3rdparty library for Windows cross-compilation support.

Cleaned up Fuzzbot build rules and made it possible to build the
Linux package from the top-most directory.

Generalized the build process in preparation for Windows
cross-complation support.

Lots of updates. Added video support. Moved all png images that were
grouped with displays to the content/displays directory. Fixed bugs
and lots of code cleanup. Added MusicBrainz, Wikipedia, IMDB and
Rotten Tomatoes support.
First implementations for Price and ISO-8601 converters.

Added new functionality to show type of audio in AwesomeBar menu. Added
title to dialog window display information. Split functionality out from
fuzzbot.js and placed into fuzzbot_ui_helper.js. Added conversion
framework for ISO-8601 and Price objects. General code cleanup and fixes.

Added buttons to take actions on certain properties of the Audio
vocabulary, such as retrieving download/sample and purchase links.

Updated Fuzzbot and audio details display and Javascript code to
implement displaying the full Audio Vocabulary. Will need to clean
up the link-based info and write something to extract pricing info
from the triples on the page.

Added audio recording detail display UI as well as first set of actions
which can search MusicBrainz for a particular artist or track name.

Added ability to display a list of audio items on a web page via a
drop-down menu cascading off of the AwesomeBar audio icon. Enabled
setting/getting the RDFa subject for each menu item and calling a
callback when the menu item is selected. Next step is to build a
UI for audio items and implement actions on the audio item.

Updated Fuzzbot to be able to detect certain types of RDF data. Namely,
people, video and audio. Will add in support for other types as needed.
Need to create dynamic menus for the data on the page next.

Added ability to embed Fuzzbot in AwesomeBar when triples are detected.
Clicking on the icon causes Fuzzbot to display the triples.

Updated Fuzzbot version number and maximum allowable version
number for Firefox 2 and 3 compatability.

Lots of UI improvements and bug fixes. Automatic RDFa detection is done on a per-tab
basis in Firefox. Added ability to disable Fuzzbot from running.

Made RDFa debug triples click-able for URIs. Hid debug triples window by
default. Need to figure out some way to automatically run triple
detection once the HTML on a page is loaded.

Lots of UI changes to enable listbox items on the bottom window instead of treelist
items. Changed layout properties of listitems at the bottom of the screen.
Updated version number to 0.7.5.

Lots of UI updates to support drop-down actions for FOAF data and proper
formatting of subjects that have dc:title and dc:abstract.
Adding first HTML UI mock-up of in-XHTML-DOM fuzzbot UI.
Cleaned up the display of the tab on the right side of the screen a bit.

Fixed a number of bugs that were causing Fuzzbot to error out when parsing XHTML in
the wild.

Added FOAF-only recognition of semantic data as a demonstration of Fuzzbot
technology.
Fixed Fuzzbot Javascript to be able to show and hide semantic data on the page.

Migrated Fuzzbot Subject UI creation from HTML file with Javascript to
the application. Fixed some wierd DOM issues when transitioning from a
pure HTML DOM to a Firefox-wrapped HTML DOM.

Updated the left arrow graphic displayed when semantic data is detected
in Fuzzbot.

Updated the first unit test for Fuzzbot and broke out the Javascript
from the HTML file. Updated the HTML file to include pictures and
names of everybody. Fuzzbot side-tab UI concept based on Margin Marks is
ready to be integrated with Fuzzbot.

Added ability to generate proper install.rdf based on which platform the plugin is
being built for.

Added test code to fuzzbot to see if we can visualize the location of
semantic data on a page. Preliminary tests are looking good, very little
CPU usage and implementation is entirely in Javascript.
Added ability to build packages for Mac OS X and Windows.
Added code to make cross-platform XPI building a bit easier to do.

Checking in changes from last night: Added ability to perform a
Javascript callback when generating triples. Added first cut at Fuzzbot
UI.

First working version of Fuzzbot. When you view a page and click the
Fuzzbot button a URI and text is sent to the C++ Fuzzbot plugin which
uses the librdfa library to parse the triples from the given document.
Checking in first install-able version of fuzzbot.

Checking in first version of the Fuzzbot Firefox extension including
base code for the component and code for the extension, including
Fuzzbot UI.
Added license which governs fuzzbot usage.
Removed console.log() call that caused Firefox to fail.
Added more documentation on how to use prefix auto-completion.
Added list removal image PNG file to Live Loop.
Finished the prefix editor for the Live Loop tool.
Fixed usability issue reported by Brian Sletten - show initial triples on load.
Added a delay before requesting that the document is parsed for triples.
Removed the external process requirement after disabling Python GIL.
Added link to Digital Bazaar website.
Finished alpha release of RDFa Live Loop tool.
Added basic README file.
Initial commit for Live Loop RDFa editing service.
Ignore lines with less than 3 characters. Apply complexity calc. at the end.
Fixed graphing algorithms to use new database caching features.

Added sqlite3 database caching support.
Broke graphs, but will fix in the next commit.
Fixed graphing style to reset code productivity every month.
Added support for JavaScript plotting via protovis.
Added language filtering to coductivity app.
Added README to the project.
Initial check-in of coductivity project.
Added Makefile - need to implement build process.
Added link to blog post.
Removed date on README file, the date is in the data itself.
Added my genome into source control.
Updated readme explaining why and the license.
first commit
